title: Python Strings
description: Strings in python are surrounded by either single quotation marks, or double quotation marks.

challenges.title: String Length
challenges.exercise: Use the len() function to print the length of the string 'Antigravity'.

challenges.title: String Indexing
challenges.exercise: Print the first character of the string 'Python'.

challenges.title: String Slicing
challenges.exercise: Print the characters from index 2 to index 5 (not included) in 'Hello World'.

challenges.title: String Methods
challenges.exercise: Convert the string 'hello' to upper case and print it.

challenges.title: String Formatting
challenges.exercise: Use an f-string to print 'My name is John and I am 36' using variables name='John' and age=36.
challenges.expectedOutput: My name is John and I am 36
challenges.solution:
name = "John"
age = 36
print(f"My name is {name} and I am {age}")
